title: Earning Basis of a Partly Refunded or Returned Line
content:
**Rule.** Under the consumer earning schedule of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships, the earning basis of the line the schedule settles reflects only the merchandise the member kept, read from the line's records on Northgate Store and Online Orders: the line itself (its net amount and the units bought), the refunds made on it without a return (the units they cover) and the returns made on it (the merchandise they refunded). The net amount is the amount paid for the line after item promotions and the Northgate Card discount, before tax, fees, gift cards and Northgate Cash.

| Records on the line | Earning basis |
|---|---|
| units refunded without a return, and none returned | the net amount multiplied by the units kept (the units bought less the units refunded without a return), divided by the units bought, rounded half up to the cent |
| units returned, and none refunded without a return | the net amount less the merchandise refunded on those returns |
| both units refunded without a return and units returned | the net amount multiplied by the units bought less the units refunded without a return, divided by the units bought, rounded half up to the cent, and then less the merchandise refunded on the returns |
| neither | no reduction applies |

The rounding to the cent applies to the prorated amount, before any returned merchandise is taken off.

**Worked cases (hypothetical line of 3 units, net amount 90.00)**

| Case | Calculation | Earning basis |
|---|---|---|
| 1 unit refunded without a return | 90.00 multiplied by 2, divided by 3 | 60.00 |
| 1 unit returned, 20.00 refunded on the return | 90.00 less 20.00 | 70.00 |
| 1 unit refunded without a return and 1 unit returned with 20.00 refunded | 60.00 less 20.00 | 40.00 |
| nothing refunded or returned | no reduction | 90.00 |

A rounding illustration: a net amount of 100.00 on 3 units with 1 unit refunded without a return gives 66.666…, rounded half up to 66.67.
